title: relay land's refusal uses internal names
what: The refusal says in plain words what is missing (a review of the change has not been recorded) and the one command or step that records it, including from a plain terminal if one exists.
why: Found 30 Oct by the trial of relay on a copy of relay cleaned of relay (owner, 30 Oct: "Полагаю что для текущих задач будет не лишним проверить подключение relay к самому relay, очищенному от relay"); sandbox HOME, RELAY_HOME and RELAY_PROJECTS, claude stubbed. After a green gate `relay land triv` refused with 'merge refused: no check mark for triv (run relay gate, then delegate:checker on its head)' (rc 2): 'check mark' and 'delegate:checker' are relay's internal names, and a newcomer without a Claude session cannot get one; the text does not say how (principle 10).
failing_case: Green gate on branch triv, no check record: `relay land triv` prints 'no check mark ... delegate:checker'.
pass_cases: the refusal names the step that records the review in plain words
a branch with a check record lands as today
